messages:
Maria Lopez: Hey everyone — I’m Maria (they/she), joining as a Product Designer today. Quick question: I got an invite to the Redwood Figma org but clicking it sends me into an SSO redirect loop. Anyone seen that before?
Samir Patel: Welcome Maria :tada: I’ll ping DesignOps. @Chen — can you take a look at SSO groups?
Chen Park: Welcome welcome! :wave: Can you DM me which email you used to sign up? We recently flipped Figma to enforce SSO + SCIM groups, so if you used a personal auth flow it can loop. Meanwhile I’ll share a temporary file link.
Maria Lopez: Sent DM — thanks. Also while I’m here, where’s the current product roadmap Notion and the research-process checklist? Want to sketch my first-week plan.
Robin Alvarez: Hi Maria, welcome! I’ll add you to Product > Roadmap in Notion. The research playbook is under Product / Playbooks / Research Sprints — I’ll give you edit access. Templates > Interview 1-pager should help for quick starts.
Chen Park: I’ve shared these two Figma files via a direct link: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/onboarding and https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/redwood-ui-kit — try opening in an incognito window if the SSO loop persists (clear cookies sometimes helps). Also make sure you’re using your @redwood.com work email.
Maria Lopez: Incognito did the trick, I can open the files now. I see a couple of team libraries (Core components + Tokens). Do I need to request edit perms or is viewer fine for the first week?
Samir Patel: For ramping, editor for the UI kit is okay so you can duplicate frames and create experimental components. We’ll lock things down for releases — no need to block your flow. @Chen can you set editor for Maria on the two libraries?
Chen Park: Done — set Maria as Editor on "Redwood UI Kit" and "Core components". Also added you to #design-system and invited you to the Figma org team. If anything still blocks, ping me here or DM.
Maria Lopez: Awesome thanks! One more: we usually include a design handoff checklist for eng — where should I put that? I have a template I like to use.
Robin Alvarez: We attach handoff notes to the component doc and create a Handoff page in the relevant Figma file, plus a linked Notion handoff (Product / Handoffs). I’ll send you the canonical template and a short walkthrough.

onboard-bot: :tada: Welcome package delivered — checklist added to Maria Lopez's profile. Please complete "security training" and "device setup" items to finish onboarding.
Maria Lopez: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone, will go through the checklist and book 1:1s. Appreciate the quick help!
